concerns.text: Tasks T060–T064 (Human Judgment Simulation) have no corresponding Functional Requirement, User Story, or Success Criterion in spec.md or plan.md. The spec defines US1-US3 and FR-001 to FR-006, none of which address simulating 'System 1' decision-maker bias or 'coherence blindness'. This constitutes scope creep; these tasks must be removed or the spec/plan must be updated to include the corresponding requirements.

Task T025 (Generate final_report.csv) is marked as unstarted (`[ ]`). This task is critical for US3 (Sensitivity Analysis & Reporting) and SC-001/SC-002 (Empirical Type I error rates). Without this task, the deliverable for the core research output cannot be produced.

Task T022b (CLI Validation for Alpha Levels) is marked as unstarted (`[ ]`). This task is required to enforce SC-004 (Sensitivity analysis coverage of at least 3 alpha levels) and FR-005. Task T022 depends on T022b, leaving the validation logic for alpha levels incomplete.

Task T023 (CLI support for alpha levels) is marked as unstarted (`[ ]`). This is a foundational task required for FR-005 and US3. Downstream tasks T033, T040, T014, T021, and T026 depend on it. The blocking chain prevents execution of the simulation and reporting.

Task T033 (CLI support for ICC range/step) is marked as unstarted (`[ ]`). This task implements FR-001 (user-specified ICC value and range). Without it, the system cannot accept user-specified ICC parameters as required.

Task T007 (CI configuration) is marked as unstarted (`[ ]`). This task implements FR-006 (CPU-only hardware execution) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility). The verification step requires the artifact to exist, but the task status indicates it is not implemented.

Task T027 description contains a non-executable pseudo-code formula string ('The memory footprint will be estimated based on...') embedded as if it were code logic. This is a writing flaw in the task specification that makes the implementation instructions ambiguous and non-concrete.
